themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including data gathering, analysis, and execution of complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and research related to assisting developers with code generation, debugging, and code review.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered tools and platforms used across various research disciplines to accelerate discovery and analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, often for research or content consumption.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Topics related to AI creating various forms of content, including text, images, audio, and video.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI techniques and tools used for analyzing datasets, uncovering patterns, and deriving insights.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Discussions surrounding the ethical considerations, risks, and responsible development of AI within research contexts.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in both the design process and user research, including generative design and AI-assisted ideation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI-generated or simulated user data and personas for research and testing.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the overall workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
